final: WITH pg AS (SELECT s.arcref AS arcref, p.fundflux AS fundflux, AVG(s.boxx * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), fg AS (SELECT fundflux, AVG(avg_ratio) AS f_avg FROM pg GROUP BY fundflux) SELECT pg.arcref, pg.fundflux, pg.avg_ratio, pg.avg_ratio - fg.f_avg AS diff FROM pg JOIN fg ON fg.fundflux = pg.fundflux WHERE pg.avg_ratio > fg.f_avg ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
